decisions.reason: As a recent launch close to the core heat-exchanger business, with certification signaling investment and no clear market failure yet, management would continue backing it.
The firm has publicly highlighted this marine box cooler system and reported a major market share in water cooling systems, so both performance and prior commitment favor continuation.

This marine cooling unit builds directly on established capabilities and was important enough to receive its own page, so management would persist while results are still early and plausibly improvable.
The compact oil cooler fits the existing portfolio and customer base, and with only a short time on the market there is too little negative evidence to justify reversing the launch.
The finned tube extends the air-cooler offering, had visible website promotion, and matches the firm's innovation path, making continued support the likely choice.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes are closely tied to the firm's engineering know-how and publicly presented as a distinct product, so management would be inclined to stay committed rather than withdraw after one year.
